name: com.wrenform/wrenform-quick
title: Wrenform Quick Forms
description: Add a working contact form to any site with no account: just the email that receives submissions.

tools.name: create_quick_form
tools.description: Create a form without a Wrenform account, using only the email address that should receive submissions. Wrenform emails that address once to confirm. Until it's confirmed, submissions are held and nothing is forwarded. Unconfirmed forms expire after 7 days. Tell the user to check their inbox and click Confirm. Pass `framework` for the right snippet, and `site_url` only if the site is already deployed (its https address).

email.description: The address that should receive the form's submissions.

site_url.description: The deployed site's https address, e.g. https://example.com; it becomes the only allowed origin. Omit it if the site isn't deployed yet (a localhost address is ignored).

framework.description: The site's framework. html needs no JavaScript.

tools.name: check_quick_form
tools.description: Check whether a quick form has been confirmed: pending_confirmation, active, expired or declined. No submission data is available here; to manage the form, the user signs in at https://wrenform.com/app.

form_id.description: The form's ID, as returned by list_forms or create_form (12 letters and digits).

tools.name: get_snippet
tools.description: Get ready-to-paste code for a form in a given framework: html (no JavaScript), html_strict_csp, fetch, nextjs, astro, react, vue, nuxt, svelte, hugo, jekyll, framer, webflow. Insert it into the site as returned; it already includes the spam honeypot.

form_id.description: The form's ID, as returned by list_forms or create_form (12 letters and digits).

framework.description: The site's framework. html needs no JavaScript.

tools.name: get_docs
tools.description: Get a Wrenform docs page as Markdown (e.g. 'quick-start', 'spam', 'redirects', 'fields', 'webhooks', 'errors', 'frameworks/nextjs').
